statements.t: Based on our year-to-date performance and current outlook, we are refining our guidance for start growth of 10% to 12% for the full year, within the previous guidance range we established following our first quarter.
Our new Hicksville, NY campus is expected to begin classes this month while the construction of our Rowlett, Texas campus continues.
During the quarter, we signed leases and advanced plans to develop campuses in the metropolitan Washington, D.C. and Phoenix, Arizona, markets.
“As we look to the remainder of 2026 and the longer-term future, based on our operational performance through October and current trends, we are raising our full-year revenue guidance.

Based on the 2026 year-to-date operating and financial results, as well as the outlook for the remainder of the year, the Company is raising its full-year 2026 revenue guidance, narrowing its student start guidance, and reiterating its guidance for adjusted EBITDA, net income, diluted EPS and capital expenditures as follows:
The reconciliations below present management’s projections of the various components included in the Company’s outlook for the full year 2026.
These calculations are furnished for illustrative purposes and will be reviewed as the year progresses to reflect actual results, the Company’s outlook and the continued relevance of specific items.
Adjusted EBITDA and net income have been reconciled to the midpoint of our guidance.
